description: This Java class 'PathModifier' provides functionality to modify URL paths using regex patterns and substitutions, supporting pattern matching, equality checks, and JSON serialization features.

classes.name: PathModifier
classes.description: A class for modifying URL paths using regex patterns and substitutions, with support for JSON serialization and equality operations.

methods.name: getRegex
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern used for path modification.

methods.name: withRegex
methods.description: Sets the regex pattern for path modification.

methods.name: getSubstitution
methods.description: Returns the substitution string used for replacing matched patterns.

methods.name: withSubstitution
methods.description: Sets the substitution string for pattern replacement.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between PathModifier objects based on regex and substitution.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on object properties for use in hash-based collections.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Lazily compiles and returns the regex Pattern object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a NottableString or String path by applying the regex pattern and substitution.
